start_sub: Your trusted assistant for keeping Telegram groups safe, clean and well-managed.
source_text: View the ArchonGuard source code and official links.
support_text: Need help or found an issue? Contact support for assistance.
help_text: Choose a category below to view its features and commands.
admin_only: This command is available to administrators only.
duration_invalid: Use a duration from 1 minute to 7 days.
media_blocked: Media is restricted during your new-member protection period.
badword_removed: Message removed for containing a prohibited word.
nsfw_removed: Inappropriate media detected. Media removed and user muted.
help_protection:
Protect new members with temporary restrictions, media control, automatic expiry and whitelist options.

Commands: /config /duration 24h /newmember on /whitelist /unwhitelist
help_members:
Manage new-member protection, duration and trusted members.

Commands: /newmember on /newmember off /duration 24h /whitelist /unwhitelist
help_nsfw:
Control protection against inappropriate photos, videos and GIFs.

Commands: /nsfw on /nsfw off
help_flood:
Detect rapid message flooding and automatically handle repeated spam.

Commands: /antiflood on /antiflood off
help_link:
Automatically remove unauthorized links from protected groups.

Commands: /antilink on /antilink off
help_warnings:
Warn members for rule violations and manage their warning history.

Commands: /warn /unwarn /warnings
help_lockdown:
Restrict normal members during an emergency while admins keep control.

Commands: /lockdown on /lockdown off
help_commands:
Admin commands for managing and configuring the bot:

/status /config /duration 24h /newmember on /antilink on /antiflood on /nsfw on /lockdown on /warn /unwarn /warnings /whitelist /unwhitelist /setbadword /delbadword /badwords
bug_missing: Please describe the problem, or reply to the affected message with /bug.
bug_cooldown: Please wait a few minutes before sending another bug report.
bug_sent: ✅ Bug report sent successfully. Thank you for reporting the issue!
bug_failed: ⚠️ Unable to send the report right now. Please try again later.
bug_unavailable: ⚠️ Bug reporting is unavailable because no logger group is configured.
welcome_message:
👋 Welcome, {name}!

Please follow the group rules and enjoy your stay.
log_chat_invalid: ⚠️ Invalid logger group ID. Please use a numeric chat ID.
